description: A purple T‑shirt lies on a light green bed sheet near a brown pillow and the wall. The left hand reaches in to grab the shirt near the collar while the right hand comes in on the lower edge, and together they pull it open and smooth it flat; then the left hand folds one side inward lengthwise, the right hand aligns and presses the edge, and both hands fold the long strip in half and then into a smaller rectangle, patting it into a neat stack before letting go.
